decision: No fixed 24k coset beats the current direct 4k lattice, so blindly taking every sixth point is not justified. The low effective cross-error correlation shows that most of the 24k gain comes from averaging several differently wrong 4k cosets. The in-sample best three-coset rule `0+1+2` has adjusted diagnostic 3.17514e-07, +0.87% versus K3, but it was selected on these same development MLPs and must be recalibrated on a disjoint split before evaluation.
